tips.title: Task + MERGE sketch
tips.body: Scheduled incremental apply with explicit Snowflake columns (no UPDATE SET */INSERT *).
tips.code:
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK load_orders
  WAREHOUSE = etl_wh
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 * * * * UTC'
AS
MERGE INTO analytics.orders t
USING raw.orders_stream s
  ON t.order_id = s.order_id
WHEN MATCHED AND s.updated_at > t.updated_at THEN UPDATE SET
  t.customer_id = s.customer_id,
  t.amount = s.amount,
  t.status = s.status,
  t.updated_at = s.updated_at
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (order_id, customer_id, amount, status, updated_at)
  VALUES (s.order_id, s.customer_id, s.amount, s.status, s.updated_at);

tips.title: Dynamic Table
tips.code:
CREATE OR REPLACE DYNAMIC TABLE mart.orders_daily
  TARGET_LAG = '15 minutes'
  WAREHOUSE = etl_wh
AS
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS d, SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM analytics.orders
GROUP BY 1;

title: Claude (Anthropic) — prompts & features
summary: Official-style tips for Claude chat: projects, artifacts mindset, strong prompt patterns, and privacy habits for DE learners.

tips.title: Clear role + task
tips.body: Start with who Claude should be and what done looks like.
tips.code: You are a patient data-engineering tutor.\nTask: explain Delta MERGE vs COPY for beginners.\nOutput: 6 bullets + 1 tiny SQL example (Spark SQL).

tips.title: Ask for assumptions
tips.body: Force hidden guesses into the open.
tips.code: List assumptions before answering. If dialect is unclear, ask.

tips.title: Structured rewrite
tips.body: Turn messy notes into a ticket-ready brief.
tips.code: Rewrite my notes into: Problem / Impact / Next checks / Risks. Keep under 120 words.

tips.title: Critique my attempt
tips.body: Learning mode — paste your work, not just ‘give answer’.
tips.code: Here is my SQL attempt (sanitized). Point out bugs, then show a corrected version with comments.

tips.title: Long-doc navigation
tips.body: When pasting long docs, ask for a map first.
tips.code: Skim and outline sections relevant to Unity Catalog grants. Then deep-dive section 2 only.

tips.title: Chat UX habits
tips.body: Use new threads per incident; keep one thread for a single lesson. Prefer copy-out of final snippets into your repo — not chat as source of truth.

tips.title: Artifacts / canvases mindset
tips.body: Ask Claude to keep a living draft (checklist, SQL file, study plan) you iteratively edit in-thread.
tips.code: Maintain a living study checklist for Prompt Engineering lesson 1–6. Update it each turn; show only the checklist.

tips.title: Privacy
tips.body: No secrets/PII. Use synthetic rows. Follow employer policy for Anthropic products.

tips.title: DE example — pipeline design
tips.code: Design a beginner-friendly daily incremental load for orders (Snowflake). Constraints: explicit MERGE columns, watermark table, no PII in examples. Output: steps + SQL sketches.

tips.title: Verify loop
tips.code: End with 3 checks I should run in Snowsight before trusting this.
